lines.text: Job wishes he knew where to find God so he could plead his case before Him.
Job cannot find God in the east, west, north or south, yet says he will come forth as silver.
Job says God is unchangeable and does what He desires, so Job is terrified in His presence.
Without covering against the cold, they are drenched by mountain rains and huddle against the caves for want of shelter.
God drags away the mighty by His power, and they are exalted for a moment, then gone.
